sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: Accepts only {}. Requires explicitly scoped unique open Design document through shared context, but not active Animation workspace. Reads Design.animationManager and class property/method descriptors; never retrieves manager.storyboards, never initializes animation assets or activates a workspace/document. Availability is API exposure, not collection readiness, action count or entitlement.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains available:boolean,profile:stable-distributed,workspaceActive:boolean|null,listAvailable:boolean,createAvailable:boolean,workspaceActivationAvailable:boolean,collectionAccess:notChecked,count:null,actionCreation:false,videoPublish:false,stop:false,limitations:string[],nativeExamples:[{operation:string,data:object}]. available means manager is not None. list/create flags require a readable class storyboards property and callable Storyboards.item/add class method. workspace activation tests class method exposure. Native example seek ref includes current document creationId and index:0 but no guarantee a board exists there. Shared envelope has success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:[]; no storyboard tokens are returned.

sections.title: Discovery Workflow
sections.text: If workspace not active, explicitly run animation.workspace {confirm:true} (mutation), then animation.list {}. Use result.storyboards[i].ref from fresh list, never nativeExamples index as discovered evidence. Missing manager makes list/create fail explicitly. Supported SDK has no action-creation/video-publish or assumed stop interface. Runtime installed API availability is live-only observation, not established by offline stubs.

examples.label: Metadata-only discovery
examples.requires: Explicit open Design document scope; inactive or uninitialized Animation workspace is allowed.
examples.output: result.collectionAccess is notChecked and count null; availability flags do not establish initialized storyboard data.

sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: Only {} accepted. Scoped open Design must already have active Animation workspace according to manager.isAnimationWorkspaceActive. No implicit activation or initialization. Missing manager fails; inactive workspace gives explicit animation.workspace confirm:true instruction. Runtime assetRoot error becomes actionable initialization error rather than empty list. Read-only branch does not require idle command itself; host read-only restrictions still apply.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {storyboards:row[],limitations:string[]}. Each row is {ref:{document:string,index:integer},isActive:boolean|null,end:number|null,playheadPosition:number|null,isInPlayMode:boolean|null,methods:{activate:boolean,play:boolean},seekExposed:boolean}. end/playhead are seconds; playhead can be -1 scratch zone. Index is zero-based collection order; document is scoped Document.creationId. Nullable properties use getattr default None. seekExposed requires writable class property descriptor, not successful seek proof. Empty list is valid only after actual initialized collection enumeration. Shared envelope has success,operation,document,result,created:[]; no name/id/entityToken storyboard fields.

sections.title: Reference Wiring And Safety
sections.text: Pass result.storyboards[0].ref intact as storyboard in inspect/activate/play/seek after verifying nonempty array. In batch list step boards, next storyboard can be {"$ref":"boards.result.storyboards.0.ref"}; standalone pass actual returned object. Relist after reorder/insertion/deletion; refs are not persistent IDs. Document creationId comparison is the handler's scope check, not universal copy uniqueness. No action enumeration, save, view mutation or workspace restoration.

examples.label: List initialized storyboards
examples.requires: Target Design is scoped; explicitly activate Animation workspace using animation.workspace confirm:true if needed before this read.
examples.output: result.storyboards[i].ref is the actual next-operation storyboard input; array may legitimately be empty.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Only required storyboard:{document:string,index:integer}; no additional nested fields. Get exact object from animation.list result.storyboards[i].ref. document must equal scoped doc.creationId; index must be nonnegative integer, not bool, and less than current collection count. Indices are zero-based and not persistent after collection edits; no names, IDs or entity tokens supported. Requires already active initialized Animation workspace; inspect does not initialize, activate board, or change workspace.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is a storyboard row directly (not {storyboard:row}): ref:{document:string,index:integer},isActive:boolean|null,end:number|null,playheadPosition:number|null,isInPlayMode:boolean|null,methods:{activate:boolean,play:boolean},seekExposed:boolean,limitations:string[]. end/playhead use seconds, -1 playhead denotes scratch zone. Missing properties are null; method/seek flags reflect callable method/writable descriptor exposure, not execution. Shared envelope created is empty. Use result.ref as subsequent storyboard input.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: No save/activation/recompute/action enumeration. Missing manager, inactive workspace, bad ref or uninitialized assetRoot produce errors, not guessed board data. Run animation.workspace confirm:true explicitly when instructed and relist. Actual installed properties remain live-only observations.

examples.label: Inspect a freshly discovered board

examples.output: result.ref identifies board; end/playhead are observed seconds without activating it.

sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: Only confirm:true required (strict boolean). Scoped Design must expose animationManager and callable activateAnimationWorkspace. Handler requires target document active/valid and UI activeCommand either empty string or SelectCommand; never terminates an interactive command. Shared mutating wrapper may activate the scoped document first. Calls workspace activation explicitly, even if active, without reading storyboards collection. No activate/storyboard fields accepted.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains only workspaceActive:boolean, actual manager.isAnimationWorkspaceActive after activation. SDK None/False activation return raises an error instead of success. No initialized/count/storyboard ref or readiness result. Envelope has success,operation,document,result,created:[]; document activation/workspace mutation are not represented as created entities.

sections.title: Safety And Next Step
sections.text: Changes shared UI workspace with no automatic restoration or save; later errors can leave activation in place. Follow with animation.list {} to establish collection readiness and retrieve actual result.storyboards[i].ref. Workspace activation alone is not evidence of initialized assets or available action-creation APIs. Actual SDK initialization behavior needs live observation.

examples.label: Explicit Animation workspace activation
examples.requires: Target Design scoped, idle UI, active valid target after any shared wrapper activation; explicit workspace switch is authorized.
examples.output: result.workspaceActive is actual readback, with no collection access or count claim.

sections.title: Inputs And Modes
sections.text: Required confirm:true. Optional clean:boolean default true, activate:boolean default false; no name,id,actions,duration fields. clean:true uses initial design transforms; clean:false inherits prior storyboard transforms per SDK. activate:true explicitly opts into Animation workspace activation if currently inactive, not guaranteed storyboard activation. Without it workspace must already be active. Target document must be active/valid, UI idle (empty/SelectCommand), manager and collection add method available. Shared wrapper may activate scoped document.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is direct row {ref:{document:string,index:integer},isActive:boolean|null,end:number|null,playheadPosition:number|null,isInPlayMode:boolean|null,methods:{activate:boolean,play:boolean},seekExposed:boolean,limitations:string[]}. end/playhead are seconds, scratch zone -1. ref document is current creationId; index is located by equality in post-add collection. No name/id/entityToken or actions field. Envelope created includes result.ref. Use result.ref for subsequent animation.activate storyboard input, not result.storyboard. Batch create step make wiring: {"$ref":"make.result.ref"}.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Workspace activation precedes collection readiness/add checks and can remain on failure. add can create board before enumeration/inspection fails; no rollback or save. Creation may change active board natively, so inspect isActive before play/seek and explicitly animation.activate if needed. Refs expire semantically after reorder/insertion/deletion; relist. No native action creation or video export supported; live SDK behavior is not verified by stubs.

examples.label: Clean storyboard with workspace opt-in
examples.requires: Explicit scoped Design and idle UI; creating a board and switching workspace if necessary are authorized.
examples.output: result.ref identifies new board and appears in envelope created; active state is observed, not assumed.

examples.label: Inherit prior transforms
examples.requires: Animation workspace already active/initialized; inheriting previous storyboard transforms is intentional.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Required storyboard:{document:string,index:integer} and confirm:true; optional activate:boolean defaults false and refers only to workspace opt-in. Discover storyboard using fresh animation.list result.storyboards[i].ref or creation result.ref. No other nested fields; document equals scoped creationId; index nonnegative integer (not bool), in current collection range. Does not use name/id/tokens. Calls board.activate() after workspace readiness. Target Design active/valid and UI idle required; wrapper may activate scoped document first.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {ref:{document:string,index:integer},isActive:boolean|null,end:number|null,playheadPosition:number|null,isInPlayMode:boolean|null,methods:{activate:boolean,play:boolean},seekExposed:boolean,limitations:string[]}. Time properties are seconds, scratch playhead -1; nullable properties reflect missing API exposure. No status/completed fields for activation, no snapshot/restored value; created stays empty. SDK activate None/False return raises. result.isActive is observed rather than a fabricated true.

sections.title: Safety And Workflow
sections.text: activate:true may switch inactive workspace before bounds/collection validation and leave it active if later failure. No restoration/save. References are nonpersistent indices; relist after changes. Use result.ref unchanged for animation.seek or play (after confirming isActive and duration). Empty boards cannot play positive intervals. Live UI behavior not established offline.

examples.label: Activate discovered storyboard with workspace opt-in
examples.requires: Fixture ref must be replaced with actual fresh animation.list result.storyboards[i].ref (or creation result.ref); document-session-id is usable only if that is the discovered creationId. Idle target Design; workspace switch authorized.
examples.output: result.isActive reports native board state; result.ref is reusable while collection order is unchanged.

sections.title: Inputs And Timing
sections.text: Required storyboard:{document:string,index:integer} from fresh animation.list result.storyboards[i].ref, and confirm:true. Optional activate:boolean defaults false (workspace only), begin/end finite JSON numbers in seconds, not strings/expressions/bools. begin defaults board.playheadPosition, end defaults board.end; require 0 <= begin < end <= board.end. Scratch playhead -1 requires explicit nonnegative begin; empty storyboard cannot play. Document ref equals scoped creationId; index nonnegative strict integer and in range, no other nested fields.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is direct row ref:{document:string,index:integer},isActive:boolean|null,end:number|null,playheadPosition:number|null,isInPlayMode:boolean|null,methods:{activate:boolean,play:boolean},seekExposed:boolean,limitations:string[], plus status:started,completed:false. Row times are seconds; result.end is storyboard duration, not echoed requested interval end. No begin field, completion polling result, video path or stop handle. created is empty. Calls board.play(false,begin,end); SDK None/False raises. started only means the API accepted playback, never completed motion.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: Board must already be active: use animation.activate explicitly. activate:true does not activate board, only workspace if inactive. Requires active valid target document and idle UI; wrapper may activate document. Workspace opt-in happens before collection/interval checks and may remain after error. No auto-restore/save, background callbacks, wait or guessed stop method. Installed playback/UI behavior is live-only.

examples.output: result.status is started, completed:false; end remains full storyboard duration.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Required storyboard:{document:string,index:integer},seconds:finite JSON number,confirm:true. Optional activate:boolean default false opts into workspace only. Discover exact storyboard ref with fresh animation.list result.storyboards[i].ref or create result.ref. document must equal scoped creationId; index nonnegative strict integer, in range; no other nested fields. seconds accepts -1 for scratch zone or 0..board.end inclusive; numeric strings/expressions/bools rejected. Target board must already be active and expose a writable playheadPosition property descriptor; no fake fallback.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {ref:{document:string,index:integer},isActive:boolean|null,end:number|null,playheadPosition:number|null,isInPlayMode:boolean|null,methods:{activate:boolean,play:boolean},seekExposed:boolean,limitations:string[]}. Time fields are observed seconds, not requested seconds echoed; -1 playhead is scratch zone. No status/completed/restored/snapshot field or media file. Envelope created stays empty. Property assignment or inspection errors propagate; no automatic restoration.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: Scoped target Design active/valid and UI idle required; wrapper may activate document. Use animation.activate explicitly before seeking; activate:true only switches inactive workspace. That switch precedes collection/time checks and may remain after error. No save or action creation. To play after scratch seek supply begin>=0, or seek back to valid range. Actual view rendering/position equivalence remains live-only verification.

sections.title: Track Schema And Discovery
sections.text: Required confirm:true,frameCount:integer 2..240 (not bool),tracks:array 1..64. Each track accepts only joint (required ref) and rotation/slide objects, each exactly {from:string,to:string}; at least one DOF required. Dimensional angular/length expressions, including compatible existing parameter references, evaluate to finite rad/cm doubles; no numeric dimensions/unitless expressions or driving equations. Tracks resolve to distinct unsuppressed Joint/AsBuiltJoint objects. Use actual joint creation result.joint or selection.inspect result.selections[0].entity; core cannot enumerate bare joint display names. Bind entity.alias to that actual ref if using example audit_joint. Native definitions in this design, including nested definitions, are usable and affect all their instances; proxies/external joints fail joint.drive. Inspect every joint first. Original values for ALL exposed DOFs, including untracked DOFs and even restore:false, must lie within actual enabled bounds; every interpolated value is checked before sampling. Linear fractions i/(frameCount-1) include both endpoints.

sections.title: Options And File Targets
sections.text: restore:boolean defaults true; realtime:boolean defaults false; delay:finite number seconds defaults 0, range 0..0.1 and nonzero requires realtime:true. checks optional array <=64, default []. Files disabled by default. frameFiles:array exactly frameCount distinct unused .png paths is exclusive with directory or prefix. directory:existing absolute Fusion-machine directory generates prefix-000.png etc.; prefix defaults frame and must match 1..64 ASCII letters/digits/_/-, requires directory. Parent directories must already exist, targets cannot exist or be symlinks; casefolded resolved paths detect duplicates. CLI maps WSL/native paths; handler receives absolute native paths, never creates destination directories. width/height strict integers 32..4096 default 1280/720; supplying either requires targets. No overwrite; atomic no-replace publication needs hard-link support. Completed files remain after failure; temporary export directories cleaned up. realtime does synchronous refresh/doEvents per frame, guarded before/after events, not accurate real-time scheduling.

sections.title: Nested Checks
sections.text: Each check accepts required measurement:{operation:string,data:object}, plus min,max OR expected with optional tolerance; bounds/expected/tolerance are compatible dimensional expression strings. At least one min/max or expected; expected excludes min/max, tolerance requires expected and is nonnegative/default zero. min<=max, inclusive bounds. Optional id/source are echoed JSON metadata (no type validation). Only measure.diameter,radius,distance,angle,length,area,volume,mass,thickness allowed; not assembly.clearance/interference or joint.drive. Checks run once at initial pose for validation (a failed acceptance there is not included in sampled pass) and at each recorded pose; measurement exceptions abort, failed acceptance continues and yields passed:false. Reference objects support token/name/kind/component/occurrence; use entity.list/selection.inspect discoveries. For moving assembly measurements explicitly qualify geometry with full root-context occurrence paths, not mixed child-native frames.

sections.title: Check Measurement Schemas
sections.text: diameter/radius/length/area/volume/mass data is {ref,units?}; radius/diameter need analytic Cylinder/Circle3D/Arc3D/Sphere, length needs BRepEdge or finite sketch curve, area allows face/profile or physical body/component/occurrence, volume/mass require body/component/occurrence (assigned material densities for mass). distance requires a,b; mode defaults minimum using entity refs and forbids direction/space. projected (unsigned) or axial (signed) modes require direction:three finite nonboolean normalized nonzero numbers and space:assembly|component local; a/b are point refs or three length-expression coordinate arrays in that space. angle requires a,b refs, optional c and units; three points use b as apex. thickness requires a,b planar faces of same body instance, optional mode only parallelPlanes, units,tolerance default 0.001 mm (nonnegative),angleTolerance default 0.001 deg (0<=angle<90 deg); faces must be parallel, noncoincident with finite-face normal overlap. No global wall proof. Supported output units/defaults: length mm(default)/cm/m/in; angle deg(default)/rad; area mm2(default)/cm2/m2; volume mm3(default)/cm3/m3; mass kg(default)/g. Expression units use compatible forms such as mm^2/mm^3. Native child manager measurements need a unique root-context occurrence; use explicit proxies if instanced more than once. No other measurement data fields.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has status:pass|fail,passed:boolean,samples:row[],frameFiles:string[],error:string|null,restoreRequested:boolean,restored:boolean|null,restoreErrors:string[],units:{rotationValue:rad,slideValue:cm},continuousMotionVerified:false,nativeStoryboardActionsCreated:false,limitations:string[]. Each sample row has index:integer,fraction:number,joints:[{joint:original input ref,rotationValue?:number,slideValue?:number}],checks:checkResult[], and frameFile:string only after successful export. Joint rows include all exposed DOFs, not only requested tracks, read after all tracks drive. checkResult is {id:JSON|null,source:JSON|null,actual:measurementResult,acceptance:{min:number|null,max:number|null,units:string},passed:boolean,status:pass|fail}. actual always includes value:number,units:string,dimension:length|angle|area|volume|mass,context:{space:string,component:ref}; scalar ref modes add ref and method, mass adds limitations, distance adds mode and either points:number[2][3] in requested units or normalized direction:number[3], angle adds method, thickness adds method/limitations. Error after sampling begins is captured as type/message string with partial rows/files; prevalidation errors raise with no result. restored is null if restore:false, otherwise indicates no tracked-value/camera-assignment restore errors (not solver rollback). passed requires no primary/restore error and all sampled checks passing. Sample can be appended before frame export failure, so samples count can exceed frameFiles count. Envelope success is false for failed result; created may include captured position snapshot refs through joint.drive only indirectly if tracked by that handler (joint.drive currently does not append snapshots to created).

sections.title: Safety And Workflow
sections.text: Requires active valid target Design, idle UI, non-Animation workspace, viewport owned by target document, and parametric history end/no pending positions. Never switches workspace or recomputes; wrapper may activate target document. Leaving Animation must be explicit. Restores every exposed DOF on tracked joints in reverse track order and camera in finally by default, then verifies joint values with 1e-9 relative/absolute tolerance. Snapshot/history/modified state remain, untracked solver-coupled motion not verified, camera assignment not rendered-view equivalence. Unsafe document/command/workspace changes abort and prevent guarded restoration. Source caveat: native/external eligibility is not checked for every track before first drive; a later invalid track can fail after earlier motion, especially dangerous with restore:false. Preflight each native joint via joint.inspect and avoid proxy/external refs. After creation step hinge, batch tracks[0].joint can use {"$ref":"hinge.result.joint"}; standalone use actual object. For image targets inspect result.frameFiles, not requested path count. Not FEA/dynamics/contact/continuous collision proof or native storyboard actions/video.

sections.title: Track Schema And Prerequisites
sections.text: Exact handler alias of motion.sample, not storyboard recording. Required confirm:true,frameCount strict integer 2..240,tracks array 1..64 distinct unsuppressed Joint/AsBuiltJoint refs. Each track is {joint,rotation?:{from:string,to:string},slide?:{from:string,to:string}} with at least one DOF, no extra nested fields. Expressions must be dimensional compatible angle/length strings, evaluated to finite rad/cm doubles (not driving equations). Discover actual joint through creation result.joint or selection.inspect result.selections[0].entity; bare names not enumerated, example audit_joint requires explicit entity.alias binding. Native definitions in this design including nested ones supported through joint.drive; proxies/external definitions rejected during driving, not all preflighted (later bad track can partially move earlier tracks). Original ALL exposed values and every sample must be inside enabled limits even restore:false. Active valid scoped Design, idle UI, non-Animation workspace, correct viewport owner, timeline end/no pending positions required; wrapper may activate document, handler never switches workspace.

sections.title: Options And Paths
sections.text: restore/realtime strict booleans default true/false; delay finite number seconds defaults 0, range 0..0.1, nonzero requires realtime:true. checks optional array <=64, defaults []. frameFiles exactly frameCount distinct absolute unused PNG paths, exclusive with directory/prefix. directory must exist on Fusion machine; prefix default frame, ASCII letters/digits/_/- length 1..64, requires directory, creates prefix-000.png etc. Parents must exist, existing files/symlinks or case-insensitive normalized duplicate targets rejected. CLI maps WSL/native paths to native Fusion paths. width/height strict integers 32..4096 default 1280/720, explicit dimensions require file targets. No files by default. No overwrite, automatic directory creation, video publishing or background timing. PNG publication uses temporary export and no-replace hard link; filesystem hard-link support mandatory. Completed files remain on failure. realtime refresh/doEvents guards document/command/workspace before/after events; delay is synchronous, not timing accuracy.

sections.title: Nested Checks
sections.text: Each check has measurement:{operation,data}, plus expected with optional nonnegative tolerance(default zero) OR at least one min/max (min<=max), optional id/source JSON metadata echoed without type checks. Bounds/expected/tolerance are dimensional strings, not bare numbers. Inclusive acceptance; no other check fields. Allowed operation only measure.diameter/radius/distance/angle/length/area/volume/mass/thickness. diameter/radius/length/area/volume/mass data is {ref,units?}; analytic Cylinder/Circle3D/Arc3D/Sphere for radius/diameter, BRepEdge/finite sketch curve for length, face/profile/body/component/occurrence for area, body/component/occurrence for volume/mass. distance data requires a,b and optional mode/units; default minimum uses refs, forbids direction/space; projected(unsigned)/axial(signed) require direction:three finite nonboolean normalized nonzero numbers,space:assembly|component local,a/b point refs or three length-expression arrays. angle data {a,b,c?,units?} uses refs, b apex for three-point. thickness data {a,b,units?,mode?,tolerance?,angleTolerance?} requires same-body-instance parallel planar faces; only parallelPlanes mode, tolerance default 0.001 mm nonnegative,angleTolerance default 0.001 deg in [0,90 deg); noncoincident finite-face normal overlap required. No global wall or material-continuity proof. Units/defaults: length mm(default)/cm/m/in; angle deg(default)/rad; area mm2(default)/cm2/m2; volume mm3(default)/cm3/m3; mass kg(default)/g. Expressions use compatible powers e.g. mm^3. Refs use discovered token/name/kind/component/occurrence objects; use explicit full root-context occurrence proxies for moving geometry and mixed definitions; native child manager measurements need a unique occurrence. Checks run at initial pose for validation then each sample; initial failed acceptance is not aggregated, sampled false checks continue and fail aggregate, exceptions abort. No assembly.clearance/interference or mutating command inside checks.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {status:pass|fail,passed:boolean,samples:row[],frameFiles:string[],error:string|null,restoreRequested:boolean,restored:boolean|null,restoreErrors:string[],units:{rotationValue:rad,slideValue:cm},continuousMotionVerified:false,nativeStoryboardActionsCreated:false,limitations:string[]}. row={index:integer,fraction:number,joints:[{joint:original input ref,rotationValue?:number,slideValue?:number}],checks:checkResult[],frameFile?:string}. All exposed joint DOFs read after all tracks drive, not only requested DOF. checkResult={id:JSON|null,source:JSON|null,actual:measurementResult,acceptance:{min:number|null,max:number|null,units:string},passed:boolean,status:pass|fail}. actual contains value:number,units:string,dimension:string,context:{space:string,component:ref}; scalar ref modes add ref,method (mass also limitations); distance adds mode,points:number[2][3] or direction:number[3]; angle adds method; thickness adds method,limitations. error catches sampling-loop exception as type/message; prevalidation errors raise without result. restored:null if restore:false, otherwise true only if no tracked/camera restore errors. passed requires no primary/restore errors and all sampled checks pass. Sample row can precede failed export, so sample/file counts can differ. Standard envelope contains success,operation,document,result,created; failed result marks success:false. No native storyboard refs/actions created.

sections.title: Restoration And Wiring
sections.text: Fractions i/(frameCount-1) linearly interpolate including endpoints. Default finally restores ALL exposed DOFs on each tracked joint in reverse order, verifies within 1e-9 relative/absolute tolerance, and attempts camera restore. Not rollback: snapshots/modified state and solver-coupled untracked state can remain; camera assignment is not visual equivalence. Unsafe document/command/workspace changes block guarded restoration and report restoreErrors separately. No computeAll (can reset motion), save, close or auto-switch. restore:false intentionally retains final/partial pose but current source still requires original values in bounds. Feed joint creation result.joint into tracks[0].joint, or in batch after step rail use {"$ref":"rail.result.joint"}; standalone supply actual object, not marker. Inspect returned actual DOFs/checks and frameFiles. This is sampled kinematics, not FEA, dynamics, contact solving, continuous collision proof, native storyboard actions or video.
